text: I looked at the engine log. From 14:17Z to 14:26Z Novig answered HTTP 502 and 504 to every request, both the public board and the read-key route. Novig's side is down or overloaded. The runner's address wasn't refused (the address-refusal counter is 0), so this isn't a block on us, and the engine can't reset a server-side outage. The engine keeps retrying on every scan, about every 30 seconds, and the 134 bids you have resting stay up. New prices will start flowing as soon as Novig recovers. Other feeds (PropLine, SportsGameOdds, Polymarket, Kalshi, BoltOdds) are answering normally, with an occasional PropLine 504. I've queued your rule: faster retries on 5xx errors, an alert to you after several minutes of the same error, and sessions diagnosing each error first. A session that holds the repo lease will build it.
